response.sql: WITH order_avgs AS (SELECT oe.ordersmark, o.timespan, AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_fill FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault WHERE oe.fillcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan), timespan_avgs AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(oe.fillcount) as timespan_avg_fill FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault WHERE oe.fillcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.timespan), filtered AS (SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.timespan, oa.avg_fill, oa.avg_fill - ta.timespan_avg_fill as diff FROM order_avgs oa JOIN timespan_avgs ta ON oa.timespan = ta.timespan WHERE oa.avg_fill > ta.timespan_avg_fill), ranked AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, diff, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC) as rank FROM filtered) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, diff, rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 3
